page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance within the Enhanced family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by a dedicated 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 24 virtual CPUs mapped across 12 physical cores with symmetric multithreading enabled. The CPU cache layout includes 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. Supported hardware instruction set extensions include AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

System memory is configured at 48.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Memory performance testing records uncached read bandwidth of 129.22 GB/sec and uncached write bandwidth of 63.67 GB/sec on 256 MB blocks, alongside a PassMark memory score of 2470.52. The instance contains no bundled local disk storage and includes no integrated GPUs, requiring non-local storage attachments for persistent filesystem needs. Baseline network throughput is provisioned at 8 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included by default.

In synthetic compute benchmarks, the ecs.c7se.6xlarge demonstrates mid-range throughput, posting a stress-ng multi-core score of 23294.91 and a PassMark CPU score of 29295.60. Geekbench testing yields 1596.0 points in single-core performance and 12129.0 points in multi-core routines, with software compilation reaching 21575.0 points. Text generation for small 135M parameter language models achieves 293.82 tokens per second, placing in the upper performance quartile, while larger 7B parameter models produce 15.59 tokens per second.

Due to its 1:2 memory profile and dedicated core allocation, the ecs.c7se.6xlarge offers resource density tuned for compute-bound tasks rather than memory-heavy datasets. The lack of integrated storage requires reliance on network block devices, making it appropriate for distributed compilation, web application processing, static web traffic handling, and batch worker nodes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.6xlarge is a compute-optimized instance offering 24 dedicated vCPUs and 48.0 GB of memory on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture with 12 physical cores and hyperthreading, it incorporates instruction sets including AVX-512 and AVX512_VNNI. The system maintains a 1:2 memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU, supported by an 8 Gbps network baseline. It includes no bundled local storage and no GPU accelerators. Benchmarks reflect balanced performance, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 12129.0, a PassMark CPU score of 29295.6, and Redis throughput reaching 23.8 million operations per second. With its compute-oriented resource balance and lack of local storage, the instance fits software build pipelines, batch processing, static web serving, and distributed API services.
